questions.topic: PrepLadder · 58.ESI Act, Factory Act, NREGA Act and Disaster Management
questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true regarding the minimum age requirements for employing children in factories as per the Factories Act?

options.label: A
options.text: Guaranteed employment for under 14-year-olds from below-poverty-line families in factories.

options.label: B
options.text: No employment for under 18-year-olds in factories.

options.label: C
options.text: Under 14-year-olds can be employed only in non-hazardous factory roles.

options.label: D
options.text: 15-18 year olds need a fitness certificate for factory work from a certified surgeon
